company_description:
The Eyak Corporation was formed in 1973 as a for-profit corporation under Alaska law pursuant to the Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act (ANCSA) enacted by Congress on December 18, 1971.

ANCSA authorized the formation of twelve regional corporations in the State of Alaska as well as a number of village corporations within each region. Eyak is the village corporation for Cordova and is one of five village corporations located within the Chugach region.

The original act did not include reference for the Native village in the Cordova area. Cecil Barnes was the Native leader who pushed the petition and enrollment drive that resulted in the formation of the Eyak Corporation. Eyak was incorporated in 1973 representing 326 original shareholders. The majority of which were of Aleut descent. Eyak was so named at the suggestion of Cecil Barnes to honor the area's Eyak Natives who had as a group been decimated by disease and poverty as a result of the development of Cordova by peoples of European descent.

In an industry that looks to its future and sees automation and artificial intelligence as the answer to the difficulties of attracting, recruiting, and selecting talent, we believe technology alone is inadequate to the challenge. Instead, we see human relationships built on trust, caring, and value as a surer path forward. We know that some see this approach as too traditional. Others suggest that there are faster ways available, like sending resumes without meeting the candidate and using outsourced recruiters to speed the acquisition of candidates. But these are false metrics. We don’t believe that placing the wrong person one day earlier benefits our client or our candidate. We prefer to judge our success by our results in placing the right person in the right position in the right company.

After 6 different high-schools my parents had basically given up on my success. I never really noticed that the adults around me didn't believe in me, though. It was sales. 

I started in sales because no one would accept me into a "BIG" boy career without a college degree, but I have stayed because I've realized I have a MASSIVE opportunity to change lives through amazing products and powerful conversations. 

In 2017, I started building sales teams because I realized I only had 8 to 10 hours per day that I was able to effectively hold space for my leads. I knew I had to hire more people if I wanted to change more lives faster. 

Here we are almost 6 years later, with no college degree and the same cavalier attitude my 7th grade math teacher hated and we've built more than 100 sales teams, taken more than 25,000 sales calls cumulatively, and sold more than $10.3M dollars for our clients. 

We are here in 2021 to do it even bigger! 

The mission? To empower and equip sales professionals to achieve freedom through high paying, remote sales careers!

Ergometrics and Applied Personnel Research, Inc. is the nation’s leader in entry-level and promotional simulation test development, and produces the most advanced, award winning, job-related tests in the industry.  Since 1981, Ergometrics’ highly validated and realistic video-simulation tests have proven to reduce adverse impact, while at the same time identify the best suited candidates within an applicant pool. As a result, hiring personnel possess a snap shot of how a candidate will perform in critical-to-success job-related situations, ultimately reducing turnover.  

In 2006, Ergometrics formed National Testing Network (NTN), the test administration arm of the company.  NTN provides continuous recruitment and testing services for public safety and transit agencies and professional licensing programs at test site locations across the United States.  Through a continuous testing model, NTN significantly increases diversity in the candidate pool, while at the same time, reducing testing costs for both departments and candidates.   

In 2008, Ergometrics began developing licensing examinations for state monitored professional licensing programs, such as: cosmetology professions, land surveyors, auctioneers, mental health technicians and waterworks professions. 

In 2015, Ergometrics began offering law enforcement, firefighter, emergency dispatch and corrections candidate background investigation services for public safety agencies.
